info.title: Traigent Content-less Negotiated Label Write Route
info.description: Negotiated label write of the content-less optimization channel (plan v2.1 phase 1b-2b, D8=A). Flag-gated (CONTENT_LESS_TOKEN_REFS_ENABLED and LABEL_SERVICE_ENABLED, both default off); issued-reference validation is governed by LABEL_VALIDATE_ISSUED_REFS (off|negotiated|global, shipped off).

post.summary: Write the next sealed revision of a label, with object_ref validated as an issued reference
post.description: TraigentBackend src/routes/optimization_label_routes.py. The legacy PUT /api/v1/labels/objects is unchanged; this route is the versioned content-less contract (body = LabelWriteRequest plus `schema_version`). Tenant and project come from the authenticated request context only (X-Tenant-Id, query strings and unknown body fields are never consulted or are refused). With LABEL_VALIDATE_ISSUED_REFS = negotiated or global, `object_ref` must be an issued reference of its kind in the caller's tenant and project, else 422 reference_not_issued; with off no validation is applied (current behaviour). While CONTENT_LESS_TOKEN_REFS_ENABLED or LABEL_SERVICE_ENABLED is off the route answers the uniform unknown-route 404, byte-identical to a path that does not exist. Not replayed by any generic HTTP idempotency layer (revision CAS, base_revision, is the write's concurrency control). ORDER OF REFUSALS: (1) unauthenticated 401 / forbidden 403; (2) body invalid 400 invalid_request; (3) object_ref not issued 422 reference_not_issued (mode-dependent); (4) stale_epoch / stale_revision / conflict 409; (5) internal_error 500. Every error body of this route is the closed envelope in label_write_schema.json#/definitions/LabelWriteRefusal except 401/403 (best_config_head_refusal_schema.json) and 429.

200.description: The stored revision (object_ref, purpose, revision, epoch, updated_at); no envelope.

400.description: invalid_request. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

401.description: unauthenticated. Closed envelope with fixed text.

403.description: forbidden. Closed envelope with fixed text.

404.description: The framework's uniform unknown-route 404 while the route is dark. No body contract (byte-identical to a path that does not exist).

409.description: stale_revision, stale_epoch or conflict. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

422.description: reference_not_issued. Closed envelope; the ref is never echoed.

429.description: Too many requests - rate limit exceeded.

500.description: internal_error. Closed envelope with fixed text; no exception data.
